description: Tenant, workspace, domain, or instance of a SaaS platform. Data residing in SaaS platforms (security-posture lens).
Synthetic or real-user monitoring of SaaS app availability and response time from multiple geographies, networks, ISPs. Captures internet/WAN path quality as seen by end users.

Canonical SaaS app in the portfolio (collaboration, CRM, productivity, design, work-management tools). Carries vendor, category, criticality tier, sanctioned/shadow flag, and links to the active subscription. Distinct from SAM's software_titles which are typically installed (or hybrid). The flagship SMP entity.

The contractual instance for a SaaS app: plan / tier, seat count, MRR or ARR, billing cadence, renewal date, primary owner. One app may have multiple subscriptions (BU, region, M&A-inherited free tier). Linked to a contract (CLM) and a PO (S2P).
Per-app per-user activity metrics: logins, time-in-app, feature usage, last-active date. The basis for license right-sizing, renewal-tier decisions, and shadow-IT vs sanctioned-app analysis.
A workplace injury, illness, near-miss, or unsafe condition, with investigation, root-cause analysis, and recordability determination.
Pay-range structure by grade and geographic zone with minimum, midpoint, maximum, and benchmarking source. Drives offer guidance, merit eligibility, and pay-equity gap analysis.

Logged touchpoint between sales and a contact/opportunity — call, email, meeting, demo, content view. SALES-ENG sub-domain may co-master if its data_objects load expands later (cadence sequences, call recordings).

Multi-step outreach sequence: touchpoint definitions (call, email, social, video, voicemail-drop), timing, branching rules based on engagement. The core entity of sales-engagement platforms; enrollment can be manual (rep choice) or automated (CDP intent signal, CRM opportunity stage).
Individual sales emails sent (1-1, not blasts) — open/reply/click tracking, thread context, sentiment. Distinct from MA `marketing_emails` (volume-scale, list-driven, brand-template-bound).
A managed sales-facing content asset (deck, one-pager, demo script) with draft, publish, and retire states.
Versioned, numbered quote document with quote date, validity, currency, terms, status (draft → presented → accepted → lost), total-price rollup. N:1 to CRM `opportunities`.
Recovery of salvageable property or proceeds from damaged/totaled assets following settlement: salvage vendor, recovery_amount, disposal record, applied against claim total. P&C-specific.
Cleaning / sanitation completion record per shift / line / equipment with verification (ATP swab, visual).
What-if strategic scenarios (M&A, market disruption, expansion). Branches EPM `financial_scenarios` and SWP `workforce_scenarios`.
Canonical schemas for data flowing through pipelines: field contracts, versioning, evolution rules. Feeds lineage.
SCORM / AICC / cmi5 content package import; carries content interop manifest and runtime state.
A safety data sheet for a hazardous substance, carrying hazard classification, exposure limits, and handling guidance for hazard communication under HazCom and REACH or CLP.
Shareholder-initiated sale of existing equity: tender offer, employee liquidity program, or direct transfer. Board-approval workflow.
Class of security in the cap table: common, preferred series (Seed/A/B/...), SAFEs, warrants. Carries liquidation preference, participation rights, conversion ratio.
DXP-local audience cluster for personalization (distinct from CDP `audience_segments` which are behavioral cross-channel).

Metric or dimension definition in the platform's semantic layer: metric views, semantic models, ontology measures, governed metrics. The reusable, governed measure consumed by BI tools and AI agents alike.
Detected over-privilege, toxic combination (PII + public access), unauthorised access, shadow-data exposure. DSPM remediation trigger.
Definition of what can be requested: the form schema, fulfillment workflow, approval routing, SLA, and the price/charge-back rules. Each service request instance references a catalog item.

Planned modification to a service or configuration item. Carries change type (standard, normal, emergency), risk score, CAB approval state, implementation window, and back-out plan. The boundary object between ITSM and CMDB — CIs are updated as a result of an executed change.
Meter-to-grid/pipe hookup asset: pole/pedestal/pit location, conductor/pipe size, install date, maintenance history. Parent to outage-impact assessment and work-order routing.
SLA-bearing service contract (response time, parts coverage, call-out fees) — distinct from CLM canonical contracts.
A quoted estimate for boatyard work: scope, labor hours, parts, and price, approved by the boater before work begins.

Unplanned interruption of, or quality reduction to, a service. Carries severity, priority, category, assignee, affected CI(s), and the MTTR clock. The flagship ITSM work item. ITOM and SECOPS feed in (events become incidents, security alerts become incidents).

Service-level objective definitions and breach state: target (e.g. 99.9% requests under 300ms over 28 days), error budget remaining, burn rate, last breach. Drives the slo.breached handoff that creates incidents.
Business-service-to-CI mapping: which CIs underlie a named business service. The bridge between technical topology (CMDB / DISCOVERY) and business impact (used by ITSM, SECOPS, OBS).
Service mesh installations: traffic policy, mTLS enforcement, distributed tracing config.

The back-end service definition (commitments, supported configurations, and fulfillment details) split from its user-facing catalog item presentation. One offering can back several catalog items, and a catalog item can present one offering.

A customer-facing outage or status record, separate from the internal incident. Captures the affected service, the public status (investigating, identified, monitoring, resolved), start and end times, and the customer-facing message. Distinct from the internal incident work item.

Recurring preventive-maintenance plan attached to an installed_equipment unit. Defines cadence, due date, grace window, and overdue escalation. Drives proactive work-order generation when the next service is due.

Root-cause record for one or more incidents that recur or share a pattern. Carries known-error workaround, permanent fix candidate, and links to the change that will resolve it. Problem management is a discipline mature ITSM tools support but most orgs underuse.
Client-facing engagement: scope, contract, start/end, billing type (T&M / fixed_fee / milestone / retainer), revenue recognition method, project manager, billing entity.

Orchestration state + task list for activation / change / closure: workflow steps, dependencies, automation/manual flags, current state, errors. Operational view of how a telco_service_order is executed.

A release or deployment record that bundles one or more changes into a single shippable unit. Carries the release window, the included changes, deployment status, and rollback plan. Distinct from a single change ticket.

Planned, catalog-driven request: access, hardware, software, information. Distinct from incidents — incidents are reactive, service requests are proactive. The fulfillment for many requests crosses domains (provisioning ↔ IGA, asset assignment ↔ ITAM, HR exception ↔ HRSD).

Service-level agreement record: response-time, resolution-time, and availability targets per priority / category / customer tier. SLAs attach to incidents, service requests, and changes; breach metrics roll up to operational KPIs.

Subscriber-reported service-degradation/outage ticket: subscriber, service, severity, opened/resolved timestamps, root cause, resolution. Distinct from ITSM `incidents` (internal IT) and FSM customer field-service tickets.
Customer-facing service job request fulfilled by field visits — distinct from VMS preventive-maintenance work orders.
Per-session attendance roster row per learner. OSHA-mandated evidence for required workplace training.
Cancellation or no-show record for an ILT session, driving waitlist promotion.

Video and audit-log artifact captured from a remote session: storage location, retention policy, redaction state, and downstream compliance evidence. Distinct artifact lifecycle from the parent remote_sessions record.
Pre-session enrollment snapshot for an ILT session; attendance proof basis.
Detected data store, file, or SaaS instance not in official inventory; unmanaged or rogue replica.

SaaS app discovered in use but not officially sanctioned. Found via expense data (corporate card SaaS charges), SSO logs (unsanctioned login), browser extensions, network traffic, or signup-with-corporate-email detection. The thing finance, security, IT, and SMP all want to see but historically nobody owns end-to-end.
Per-shareholder holding record across all security classes for an issuer.

A worker-initiated request to swap or give up a shift, or to pick up an open shift, conducted as a conversation on the worker's device and routed for manager approval before handoff to the workforce-management schedule.

Operator-initiated issue/escalation: andon pull, quality defect escape, safety concern, equipment anomaly, material shortage. Work item for shop-floor problem-solving team. Distinct from FSM support tickets.

E-signature envelope: signing audit trail, IP addresses, external e-signature provider envelope and document reference IDs, and the signed PDF artifact. Distinct from contracts, one contract may have many signature events (counterpart, amendment, renewal).
Connection metadata to downstream targets: auth, batch/stream mode, upsert keys, schema enforcement rules.

Special Investigation Unit fraud-investigation case: claim reference, indicators triggered, investigator, status (open / closed-confirmed / closed-unconfirmed), referral to law enforcement. Distinct from generic banking/compliance investigations.
Discrete proficiency-rating event against a skill, with rater, method (self, manager, peer, test), score, and timestamp.
Peer or manager validation of a claimed or inferred skill on a profile; one-shot social signal distinct from a formal assessment.
Audit record of a passive skill-inference batch on skill profiles: model version, input signals (learning, performance, work activity), outputs, timestamp.

Per-worker collection of skills with self-assessed and validated proficiency levels, derived from completed courses, certifications, performance signals, and inferred peer-comparison. The central artifact of HCM-side skills-cloud and talent-intelligence offerings.
A learning-path step bound to a skill plus a target proficiency threshold.
Versioned ontology of skill nodes, synonyms, parent-child relationships.
Individual skill node belonging to a taxonomy version; the row referenced by every profile entry, competency-model entry, and inference run.

Comparison of current-state skills inventory vs future-state demand by role, level, and geography. Drives build/buy/borrow strategy: which gaps to close via training (LMS), external hires (ATS), or contingent workforce. Outputs feed both SWP scenarios and LMS curriculum decisions.
The placement of a specific vessel in a specific slip, mooring, or rack for a period, linking inventory to a reservation or contract.
A seasonal or annual agreement licensing a slip, mooring, or rack to a boater: term, rate, included utilities, and renewal terms.
A request to dock or store a vessel for a transient or seasonal period: dates, vessel, requested space, rate, and check-in/out status.
A configured size class for slips and racks (length and beam bands) used for fit rules and rate lookup.
A boater's place in line for a slip type or period that is currently full, with offer and expiry tracking.

System-raised anomaly on the SaaS portfolio: shadow-IT signup detected, license-overage projected, renewal window opening, integration token expiring, vendor-risk score change. Distinct from monitoring_alerts (OBS/AIOPS infrastructure-grain). BetterCloud Alert Center and Torii Alerts are the flagship surfaces.

Per-app utilization and cost-per-seat benchmark vs an industry peer-set. Snapshot record per measurement period; carries headcount cohort, peer-percentile, and outlier flag. Productiv Benchmarks + Zylo Industry Benchmarks are the flagship.

Curated, published listing of a sanctioned SaaS application that employees can browse and request access to. Carries description, owner, request route, SSO availability, approval workflow. Distinct from saas_applications (the discovered inventory of what's running); the catalog is the publication of what's offered. LeanIX, Torii, BetterCloud flagship.

Discovered or configured connection between SMP and a SaaS application's APIs (SSO source, SCIM source, finance source, usage source). Per-app per-tenant, with auth state and last-sync time. Distinct from IPAAS integration_connectors (platform-grain vendor-connector definitions); BetterCloud's App Integrations flagship surface.

Portfolio-rationalization stage of a SaaS application (Evaluate, Pilot, Sanctioned, Sunset, Retired). Distinct from saas_applications.record_status (discovered, sanctioned, deprecated, deprovisioned), which tracks discovery state. The stage set follows the industry-standard TIME portfolio taxonomy (Tolerate, Invest, Migrate, Eliminate).

Typed role assignment of a user to a SaaS application (business owner, IT owner, finance owner, security owner). Not a flat FK on saas_applications because one app may have multiple typed owners; modeled by Productiv and LeanIX as a first-class junction.

Employee request for access to a SaaS application via the published catalog. Routes through manager + IT approval, then hands off to IGA for entitlement provisioning. App-grain (pre-IGA-handoff); distinct from iga_access_requests (entitlement-grain) and itsm_service_requests (generic catalog). Torii App Catalog requests + BetterCloud Self-Service Requests are the flagship.

Declarative orchestration: trigger + steps (provision in SaaS app, send notification, file offboarding action, request approval, escalate). BetterCloud Workflows + Torii Workflows are the flagship product surface. Distinct from iga_access_requests (request-side) and integration_recipes (generic iPaaS).

SMP's view of a user-to-app license seat: who holds a seat at which tier, cost-per-seat, utilization signal, last active. Drives reclamation and rightsizing. Correlates with an iga_user_entitlement record (the governance view of the same access fact); the two routinely diverge.

System-generated rightsizing or consolidation proposal against a SaaS subscription or application. Carries savings_estimate, rationale, recommendation type (downgrade tier, reduce seats, consolidate apps), status. Productiv Recommendations + Zylo Savings Opportunities are the flagship.

Executed reclamation against an smp_license_seat_assignment (revoke, downgrade, reassign) with savings_realized linkage. Tracks the operational payoff of the optimization workflow. BetterCloud License Recovery + Torii Reclaim workflows are the flagship.

Lifecycle envelope per renewal cycle: timeline, owner, vendor proposals received, BATNA notes, decisions taken. Buyer-side analog of CRM opportunities; distinct in that the buyer drives the negotiation. Productiv Renewal Pipeline + Zylo Renewal Workbench are the flagship.
Workstream task within a SaaS renewal cycle (renewal window notice, owner assignment, decision: renew/renegotiate/consolidate/cancel). Productiv, Zylo, Flexera Renewal workspace surfaces.

Chargeback split of a SaaS subscription across cost centers, business units, or projects, with allocation method (per-seat, per-headcount, fixed-percentage) and effective window. Zylo Cost Center Allocation + Flexera Chargeback Allocations are the flagship. Distinct from FINOPS cost_allocations (cloud-only).

Quote, counter-quote, and discount-applied artifact tied to a renewal engagement. Decision-provenance record for how the final commercial terms were reached; contributor into CLM at execution time. Productiv Negotiation Intelligence + Zylo negotiation insights are the flagship.

SaaS-specific vendor-risk scorecard: SOC 2 attestation status, ISO 27001, DPA review, subprocessor disclosures, breach history, posture score. Per-SaaS-application (Slack vs Salesforce risk profiles differ from the same vendor). Flexera Vendor Risk Scorecard is the flagship; pure-plays defer most risk surfaces to GRC.
Execution log per automation workflow invocation. Carries trigger source, input payload, step-by-step status, output, duration, and error if failed.

Brand-owned connected account on a specific social network with credentials, permissions, and channel-specific metadata. Covers major short-form, long-form, video, image-sharing, professional, and discussion-forum networks.
A connected advertiser account on a social ad platform (Meta Business, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, etc.) under which campaigns are run and billed.
A paid social campaign defining an advertising objective, schedule, and overall budget, parenting one or more ad sets across one or more ad platforms.
A versioned ad creative: the assembled visual-plus-copy unit (single image, video, carousel, collection) with approval state and platform-specific renditions, used by ads across campaigns.
Time-series delivery and outcome metrics per ad, ad set, or campaign (impressions, clicks, spend, conversions, ROAS, CPA, frequency) pulled from ad-platform insights APIs.
A targeting and budget unit within a campaign (Meta ad set, TikTok ad group, LinkedIn campaign tier) binding an audience, placements, bid strategy, schedule, and budget to a set of ads.
An individual deliverable ad within an ad set, pairing a creative with destination and tracking parameters and carrying its own delivery and review state on the ad platform.
Saved monitoring query/topic (keywords, hashtags, competitors, geographies, sentiment filters) that drives the listening pipeline. Configuration data with a long lifecycle.

Brand or keyword mention detected by social listening across networks, news, blogs, forums, and review sites — typically off-channel and from non-followers. Distinct from social_messages (on-channel inbox).

Inbound conversation in the unified inbox: comment, direct message, mention-reply, or review on a brand-owned account. The unit of engagement. Distinct from social_mentions (off-channel listening artifacts).
Authored social-channel post (draft, scheduled, or published) with per-channel variants, media assets, copy, lifecycle state, and approval history. The unit of work in publishing tools.

Release event of a build_artifact to a target environment (dev / staging / prod): deployer, started/finished timestamps, status, rollback flag, target environment, change-ticket reference. Scope-qualified vs `device_deployment_results` (UEM).

Discovered install of a software title on a specific device or for a specific user. The operational fact, distinct from the licensing right. Discovery feeds; VULN-MGMT reads to scope vulnerability scans.
